description: Authoritative high-fidelity multiphase CFD for OUTRAM-FOAM: drift-flux, Euler-Euler two-fluid, wall boiling, CHF/CHF-subcooling, dryout/post-dryout. This is the REFERENCE implementation from which TAMPINES 1D reduced-order physics (epic op-dt3) are derived — 1D physics must trace back to a validated 3D reference here, never be invented independently. Roadmap Stages 1-5 are child beads, dep-chained in order. Definition of done for EVERY solver bead: (a) theory documentation, (b) verification tests, (c) reference-benchmark comparison, (d) unit-safe uom implementation; humans own physics/V&V/benchmarking/engineering judgement, AI only accelerates translation. Workspace hard rules apply (enum dispatch not dyn, no lifetimes, Arc, GPLv3+OpenFOAM provenance headers, Android-buildable non-GUI lib). CRATE PLACEMENT (extend outram-foam-appbuilder-lib op-p6p vs a new outram-foam-multiphase crate) is a maintainer design decision — recorded here, not presumed. Source: Theodore Ong, 'OUTRAM PARK Phase II Architecture', 2026-07-23 (rough instruction set; outram-park-backend CLAUDE.md takes precedence).
title: OUTRAM-FOAM Phase II — multiphase CFD reference physics

description: The ComputeType backend selector (op-u6s.4, 2026-07-17) currently only dispatches inside run_keff (the bare-sphere homogeneous driver). Extend CpuMultiThread + Gpu support to run_keff_csg (transport_csg), run_keff_mg (physics_mg), and run_keff_delta (pebble_beds/keff_delta) so the selector works across all k_eff drivers. Multi-thread is the natural first extension (rayon over histories, per-history jump-ahead seeds); GPU XS lookup needs a per-material UnionTotalXs since CSG has multiple cells/materials.
title: outram-mc: honour ComputeType in CSG/MG/delta k_eff drivers
